import sys


class LibraryBook:
    def __init__(self):
        self.__bookTitle = ""
        self.__bookID = 0
        self.__daysLate = 0
        self.__fineAmount = 0.0

    def setDetails(self, title, book_id, late_days):
        self.__bookTitle = title
        self.__bookID = book_id
        self.__daysLate = late_days
        self.__fineAmount = 0.0

    def calculateFine(self):
        if self.__daysLate <= 5:
            self.__fineAmount = self.__daysLate * 2
        else:
            self.__fineAmount = self.__daysLate * 5

    def display(self):
        print(f"Book Title: {self.__bookTitle}")
        print(f"Book ID: {self.__bookID}")
        print(f"Days Late: {self.__daysLate}")
        print(f"Fine: {self.__fineAmount:.2f}")


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 3:
        return
    title = data[0]
    book_id = int(data[1])
    late_days = int(data[2])

    book = LibraryBook()
    book.setDetails(title, book_id, late_days)
    book.calculateFine()
    book.display()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
